findings.title: One-sided termination for convenience
findings.deviation: Clause 8.3 grants TravelHub the right to terminate for convenience upon 30 days' notice, but does not provide AtliQ with a reciprocal termination right.
findings.impact: TravelHub holds a unilateral right to terminate for convenience while AtliQ does not have a corresponding right.
findings.quote: TravelHub may terminate for convenience with thirty (30) days' written notice and shall pay for all work performed up to the termination date.
findings.counterPosition: Make termination for convenience mutual, allowing either party to terminate on 30 days' written notice with payment for all work performed and committed costs incurred up to termination.

findings.title: Data transfer restriction and missing DPA
findings.deviation: Clause 14.2 restricts transferring Customer Data outside TravelHub's cloud environment without prior written approval and lacks an executed Data Processing Addendum covering offshore access for AtliQ's development team.
findings.impact: AtliQ's offshore development team cannot access Customer Data without prior written approval and a formal DPA.
findings.quote: AtliQ shall not transfer Customer Data outside the TravelHub cloud environment without prior written approval.
findings.counterPosition: Execute a formal Data Processing Addendum (DPA) including sub-processor authorization for AtliQ's Indian entity and explicitly agreeing to de-identified offshore access terms prior to data processing.

fine.note: No delay penalties present in the agreement.
Liability cap is mutual at 1x fees paid in prior 12 months with standard carve-outs.
Indemnity is narrow and balanced, covering IP infringement and customer data compliance.
IP assignment occurs upon full payment with background technology retained by AtliQ.
Confidentiality terms are mutual with standard exceptions and a 3-year duration.
Non-solicitation obligation is mutual and limited to 12 months for direct project staff.
Acceptance process includes a 10-day review period and deemed acceptance.
60-day warranty for material conformity is standard.
